description: Find pinball machines: "what pinball games has Stern made?", "which machines are in production?", "pinball games from 1992". Searches and filters the Kineticist pinball game database. Supports text search, manufacturer filtering, year ranges, production status, and sorting. Returns game names, slugs, manufacturers, fun scores, edition counts, and each game's page URL on kineticist.com (link it when citing a game). `newest_edition_year` is the year the newest edition came out, not the year production ended; `in_production` says whether the game is still made.

in_production.description: Filter to only games currently in production (true) or out of production (false)

manufacturer.description: Filter by manufacturer name or slug (fuzzy match — 'stern' works)

q.description: Text search by game name (fuzzy, 2+ chars). Natural language works — 'that stern game with dinosaurs' will find Godzilla.

sort.description: Sort field. Prefix with - for descending. Options: name, first_manufacture_year, average_fun_score, ratings_count

name: search_pinball_games
title: Search pinball games
